'''Vince Ebert''' (born 23 May 1968) is a German comedian, lecturer,<ref>„…mittlerweile auch Vortragsredner…“ [http://www.weltwoche.ch/ausgaben/2016-5/artikel/vince-ebert-die-weltwoche-ausgabe-52016.html ''MvH trifft: Vince Ebert''] in: [[Die Weltwoche]], Ausgabe 5/2016; [http://www.vince-ebert.de/vortraege/ Selbstdarstellung]</ref> presenter, author, and recipient of a degree in [[physics]].

==Education, career, private life==
Born in [[Miltenberg]] as Holger Ebert, Ebert grew up in [[Amorbach]] in [[Lower Franconia]] ([[Bavaria]]). Ebert's classmates gave him the name "Vince" when he was 14 years old because he was a fan of [[Vince Weber]].<ref name="derwesten.de">[http://www.derwesten.de/ikz-start/steinzeit-menschen-in-hugo-boss-anzuegen-id9253701.html ''Interview mit Vince Ebert: „Steinzeit-Menschen in Hugo-Boss-Anzügen.“''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150923213823/http://www.derwesten.de/ikz-start/steinzeit-menschen-in-hugo-boss-anzuegen-id9253701.html |date=23 September 2015 }} In: ''[[Westdeutsche Allgemeine Zeitung]]'', vom 17. April 2014.</ref> After his [[military service]] with the [[Signal Corps]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Drei Komiker entern das Lesezelt|publisher=[[Journal Frankfurt]]|url=http://www.journal-frankfurt.de/journal_news/Leute-3/Hirschhausen-Schroeder-und-Ebert-Drei-Komiker-entern-das-Lesezelt-17010.html|accessdate=29 September 2014|last=Nicole Brevoord|date=12 October 2012}}</ref> he studied [[physics]] at [[University of Würzburg|Julius Maximilian University]] in [[Würzburg]] from 1988 to 1994 and majored in [[Experimental physics|experimental solid state physics]] and minored in [[astronomy]].<ref name="derwesten.de" /> He earned his degree in physics in 1994.

Ebert worked from 1995 to 1997 as a consultant at the management consultancy Ogilvy & Mather Dataconsult in [[Frankfurt am Main]]. He discovered his talent for [[satirical revue]] while giving [[Slide show|PowerPoint presentation]]s.<ref name="fnp">{{Cite web |url=http://www.fnp.de/lokales/frankfurt/Zufaellig-Vince-Ebert;art675,1162868 |title=Archived copy |access-date=6 December 2014 |archive-date=6 December 2014 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20141206115830/http://www.fnp.de/lokales/frankfurt/Zufaellig-Vince-Ebert;art675,1162868 |url-status=dead }}</ref> From 1997 to 2001 he worked as a strategic planner for the [[advertising agency]] Publicis in Frankfurt.

He is married to actress [[Valerie Bolzano]].<ref name="fnp" />
In 1994 he became Bavarian champion in beach volleyball.<ref>[http://www.volleyball.bayern/index.php?id=43 Bayerische Beachvolleyballgeschichte]</ref>

==Satirical comedy==
In 1998 Ebert made his first appearances as a comedian on various revue stages. He presented his first solo set Die jetzt aber wirklich große Show (Now A Really Great Show) in 2001 at the Neues Theater Höchst. He was discovered by Susanne Herbert, Eckart von Hirschhausen's. manager.<ref name="fnp" /> Under the direction of Eckart von Hirschhausen, he created his first science satire program: "Urknaller – Physik ist sexy ("Big Bang – Physics is Sexy"). The premiere took place in 2004 at Frankfurt's "Käs".<ref name="fnp" /> Although he is an atheist, he performed at the [[German Evangelical Church Assembly]] (Evangelischer Kirchentag) in [[Hamburg]] in 2013.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.derwesten.de/ikz-start/steinzeit-menschen-in-hugo-boss-anzuegen-id9253701.html |title=Thomas Reunert, "Steinzeit-Menschen in Hugo-Boss-Anzügen" |access-date=18 April 2014 |archive-date=23 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150923213823/http://www.derwesten.de/ikz-start/steinzeit-menschen-in-hugo-boss-anzuegen-id9253701.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> Since September 2016 Ebert has been touring Germany, Austria and Switzerland with his seventh solo routine Zukunft is the Future (Future is Future).<ref>Vince Ebert: [https://www.vince-ebert.de/live-shows/ Freiheit ist alles.]</ref>
In 2014 he and Eric Mayer started a family-friendly science show "Schlau hoch 2 – Vince and Eric reisen zu den Sternen"<ref>{{cite web|title=SCHLAU HOCH 2 – Eine Wissens-Show für die ganze Familie|url=http://www.schlauhochzwei.de/|accessdate=15 August 2017|archive-date=15 August 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170815190816/http://www.schlauhochzwei.de/|url-status=dead}}</ref> ("Clever squared – Vince and Eric Travel to the Stars"). In his comic work he explores scientific concepts.<ref>Schweizer Monat: [http://www.schweizermonat.ch/artikel/einstein-wuerde-sich-im-grabe-umdrehen «Einstein würde sich im Grabe umdrehen»], April 2011.</ref>

===Solo programs===
*2001–2003: Die jetzt aber wirklich richtig große Show (Now A Really Great Show)
*2003–2004: Alles gelogen (All Lies) (Director: [[Mathias Repiscus]])
*2004–2007: Urknaller – Physik ist sexy (Big Bang – Physics is Sexy) (Director: [[Eckart von Hirschhausen]])
*2007–2010: Denken lohnt sich (Thinking Pays Off) (Director: Eckart von Hirschhausen)
*2011–2013: Freiheit ist alles (Freedom is Everything) (Director: Eckart von Hirschhausen)
*2013–2016: Evolution (Director: Jim Libby)
*2014–2016: Schlau hoch 2 – Vince und Eric reisen zu den Sternen (Clever squared – Vince and Eric Travel to the Stars) (with Eric Mayer)
*As of 2016: Zukunft is the Future (Future is Future) (Director: [[Jim Libby]])
*As of 2018: Sexy Science (English Show, e.g. at [[Edinburgh Fringe]])

==Events and shows==
Ebert also moderates events such as the "Felix Burda Award", the "Brand Gala" and the annual ThyssenKrupp IdeenPark reception (co-moderated by [[Thomas Gottschalk]]). In his capacity as [[Keynote (presentation software)|Keynote speaker]], he gives lectures on scientific and economic topics, at the Alpensymposium, for example, or on Bühnen des Wissens (Sprecherhaus). Also in English since 2016.<ref>{{cite web|title=Why success is not predictable {{!}} Vince Ebert {{!}} TEDxHHL|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QC8svQCxbT4|accessdate=15 August 2017|last=TEDx Talks|website = YouTube|date=11 November 2015}}</ref>

==Television==
Ebert appears in various Television shows such as [[Mitternachtsspitzen]] ([[Westdeutscher Rundfunk|WDR]]), [[TV total]] ([[ProSieben]]) and is also a regular guest on talk shows such as [[Markus Lanz]] ([[ZDF]]), the [[NDR Talkshow]] and the [[Kölner Treff]] (WDR).
Between 2009 and 2011, Ebert appeared as a "guest lecturer" on the WDR show Der dritte Bildungsweg, which was moderated by [[Jürgen Becker (comedian)|Jürgen Becker]] during this time. In 2012, together with [[Eckart von Hirschhausen]], he hosted a season.

Ebert has been hosting the show Wissen vor acht – Werkstatt ("Science Before Eight – Workshop") on [[ARD (broadcaster)|ARD]] since 2011, where he explains interesting concepts in physics in less than three minutes.

==Philanthropy==
Vince Ebert is a patron of the [[Galileum Solingen]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Vince Ebert ist Schirmherr des Galileums!|url=http://galileum-solingen.de/vince-ebert-ist-schirmherr-des-galileums/|accessdate=26 November 2017|language=de-DE|date=5 June 2014|archive-date=1 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201044247/http://galileum-solingen.de/vince-ebert-ist-schirmherr-des-galileums/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Additionally he sponsors the Technoseum's "Jugend für Technik" (Youth for Technology) initiative in [[Mannheim]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Jugend für Technik – Prominente Unterstützung|url=http://www.technoseum.de/news/jugend-fuer-technik/prominente-unterstuetzung/|accessdate=26 November 2017|language=de-DE}}</ref> He is also an ambassador for the MINT Zukunft schaffen and for the Stiftung Rechnen which aims to impart basic mathematical and scientific knowledge.<ref>{{cite web|title=Vince Ebert – Soziales Engagement|url=http://www.vince-ebert.de/soziales-engagement/|accessdate=26 November 2017|language=de-DE|archive-date=1 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201041714/http://www.vince-ebert.de/soziales-engagement/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
